# Royal Ruby x402

> Pay $0.25 USDC, get structured US consumer-rights law citation research (FCRA, FDCPA, TILA, state UDAP, reporting timelines, statute of limitations).

- Paid endpoint: POST https://royal-ruby-x402.fly.dev/api/law-lookup
- Current configured price: $0.25 USDC per request
- Payment network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453), USDC via x402
- Intended users: paralegals, journalists, consumer-rights AI agents, dispute-letter drafting bots
- x402 manifest: https://royal-ruby-x402.fly.dev/.well-known/x402.json
- OpenAPI: https://royal-ruby-x402.fly.dev/openapi.json
- Health: https://royal-ruby-x402.fly.dev/health
- Free sample: https://royal-ruby-x402.fly.dev/sample
- Note: informational only, not legal advice; verify citations independently.
